texts: One year after the Cox-Maze IV procedure, about 80 percent of patients are free of atrial fibrillation without antiarrhythmic drugs: B.
In the picture, eight of the ten Pinocchios leave the maze still and without pills after a year.
A biatrial lesion set, the maze across both lobbies, gives better late freedom from AF than a left-sided set alone.
Isolating the whole posterior left atrium, the box lesion, also improves drug-free success.
Memory hook: after a year in the maze, eight of ten stand still without pills.
